kicker: 30.7B DENSE · 256K CTX · APACHE-2.0 · Q4_0 QAT CHECKPOINT · HERETIC LINE
title: Gemma 4 31B, uncensored from the QAT checkpoint
summary: Google's Gemma 4 31B (30.7B dense, 60 layers, 256K context, text and image input, Apache 2.0) has been uncensored repeatedly in 2026. coder3101's April Heretic v1.2.0 + ARA edit reports refusals 15/100 vs 99/100 at KL 0.0434; wnfldchen's 14 August rebuild on the Q4_0 quantisation-aware checkpoint reports 8/100 vs 99/100 at KL 0.0900 with a reproduction kit and a W4A16 capability table; OS-Software's 8 September release, made with a Heretic v2.0.0.dev0+custom development build, reports 0/100 against 100/100 for the stock checkpoint at KL 0.0083, shipping a 17.29 GB Q4_0 GGUF plus a 1.20 GB or 0.81 GB vision projector. EXL3 and Q4_0 requants, an expert-pruned 26B A4B variant, an E4B decensor (7/100 at KL 0.0043) and a separate Madras1 orthogonalization line complete the picture. All refusal and KL numbers are publisher-measured; no GPU was rented and no inference was run for this article.
refusal_claim: Publisher-measured on Heretic's 100-prompt screen: 0/100 vs 100/100 for the stock QAT checkpoint at KL 0.0083 (OS-Software, 8 Sep 2026, Heretic v2.0.0.dev0+custom); 8/100 vs 99/100 at KL 0.0900 (wnfldchen, 14 Aug 2026); 15/100 vs 99/100 at KL 0.0434 (coder3101, 2 Apr 2026); E4B 7/100 vs 99/100 at KL 0.0043 (Alfredofrog, 11 Sep 2026). Test-specific claims, not universal zero-refusal guarantees.

kicker: 552B-8B MOE · 1M CTX · MIT · DAY-ONE UNCENSOR WAVE
title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, uncensored within a day
summary: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash on 10 September 2026 (552B backbone, 8B/16B active per token, causal encoder-decoder, 384 routed experts, Engram memory, 1M-token context, MIT) and three independent uncensored builds followed within 19 hours. s-zaizen's Heretic edit (commit 3521f864) cut refusals 97/100 to 24/100 on the same 100-prompt keyword screen. msuiche's 800 KB GLP-39 control vector, gated, raised compliance 4/32 to 24/32 on a refusal set and 5/32 to 31/32 on a cyber set at alpha 0.5, with the card showing alpha 2.0 regresses and damages English. dealignai's CRACK-brand weight edit reports 320/320 HarmBench-320 compliance versus 137/320 stock at reasoning off, MMLU 86.96% to 82.74% (-4.22pp; -1.1pp excluding ethics). No released runtime serves deepseek_v41 yet: an SGLang preview branch and community forks do. Publisher-measured claims; no GPU was rented and no inference was run for this article.
refusal_claim: Publisher-measured: s-zaizen 24/100 vs 97/100 (Heretic keyword screen, seed 42); msuiche 24/32 and 31/32 at alpha 0.5 (no-op gate at alpha 0); dealignai 320/320 vs 137/320 HarmBench-320 at reasoning off. Test-specific claims, not universal zero-refusal guarantees.

title: MiniCPM5-2B, uncensored and reproducible
summary: OpenBMB shipped MiniCPM5-2B on 6 September 2026 (2,516,756,480 params, dense LlamaForCausalLM, 131,072-token context, Apache-2.0, open UltraData training sets) with a card claiming 2B-class SOTA at 53.9 average, above every listed 4B rival. Stock, insraq's screen measured 99 refusals of 100 prompts. Thirty-four hours later his Heretic v1.4.0 edit, trial 254 of an Optuna Pareto search, measured 5/100 at KL 0.0391 on the same screen, and it ships a reproduction kit: base commit 3497c460, pinned prompt datasets, RNG seed, full Optuna journal and SHA256SUMS, so a rebuild is byte-checkable. GGUF (F16 5.04 GB to IQ3_M 1.23 GB) and Apple MLX 4-bit packs followed within two days. Publisher-measured claims; no GPU was rented and no inference was run for this article.
refusal_claim: 5/100 refusals vs 99/100 on the same 100-prompt harmful-behaviors screen (mlabonne sets, commit-pinned), KL 0.0391, trial 254 of 254, publisher-measured by insraq, reproducible via the shipped kit. Not a universal zero-refusal claim.

kicker: 4.1B/1.7B · HYBRID SWA · 1M CTX · APACHE-2.0 · DAY-TEN UNCENSORS
title: Day ten for Spark X2.5: the uncensor wave on the 1M-context 4B
summary: XHToken's SparkLLM shipped Spark-X2.5-4B (4,112,079,360 params) and -1.7B on 24 Aug 2026: Apache-2.0, hybrid attention (one full-attention layer per three sliding-window layers), up to 1M-token native context claimed, 200+ languages, trained on Huawei Ascend, and vendor agent benchmarks (τ³-bench 30.4 vs Qwen3.5-9B 9.3, AIME 2026 90.7) that outrank 9B/12B rivals. Stock, the small models refuse hard: 2,014/3,911 (51.5%) marker refusals on the 1.7B, 186/300 sealed, 100/100 sealed adversarial. Ten days after the drop the uncensors landed measured: soyaakinohara's BF16 Heretic of the 4B (58→3/100 refusals, KL 0.0118, base revision pinned, JP-adapted twin and a GGUF ladder to Q4_K_M 2.5 GiB) and darioooooo0o's 1.7B ablation (0 real refusals on 337 eye-audited generations vs 186/300 base, sealed sets, bucket ruler), plus a methodology argument about how to count refusals on thinking models. Runtime reality check: upstream llama.cpp lacks spark2_5; the vendor's own fork serves it, and an open GitHub issue asks for an official 1M-context reproduction config.
refusal_claim: 4B Heretic (soyaakinohara): 3/100 refusals vs 58/100 base at KL 0.0118, editor-measured. 1.7B ablation (darioooooo0o): 0 real refusals on 337 eye-audited generations (300 sealed + 37 answer-level) vs 186/300 base on the same prompts, editor-measured bucket ruler; marker matrix 51.5%→6.7% printed for comparability, not as a claim.

kicker: 285B-A13B · VISION MOE · FIRST MULTIMODAL V4 · 11-HOUR ABLITERATION
title: Eleven hours from DeepSeek drop to uncensor.
summary: DeepSeek's first open multimodal model (285B total / 13B active MoE, 1M context, 32-layer vision tower, DSpark self-draft) landed 31 Aug 2026 at 06:16 UTC; apetersson's rank-1 abliteration (33 attention-output tensors, layers 10-42, strength 3.5, L2-preserving) followed at 17:12 UTC. Text and image smoke tests pass, broader evaluation pending; ~202 GB FP8-native, ~$10.90/h managed on 2 x H200. Within a day s-zaizen grafted the edit onto NVFP4 (8/8 safe prompts, 0 refusals, GSM8K 99/100) and audreyt onto an IQ2_XXS ds4 GGUF; every derivative pins the donor revision.
refusal_claim: No refusal-evoking benchmark published (card: evaluation pending). Closest: s-zaizen NVFP4 descendant 8/8 safe-boundary prompts answered, zero refusals; GSM8K 99/100 (+3.0 vs unedited NVFP4 base).

title: The 118B coding MoE nobody has refused

A second independent build of the same base (Bizarrrr, on FriendliAI) measures EN refusals 92.71%→2.33%, DE 74.49%→4.23%, HumanEval 90.24%→85.37%.

title: The 1-bit uncensor: can a refusal direction survive 1.125 bits per weight?
summary: The Bonsai family, the most downloaded 1-bit experiment of the summer (1.95M downloads on the MLX pack alone), gained an uncensored branch this morning: a Heretic v1.4.0 decensor of Bonsai-27B (6/100 refusals vs 81/100, KL 0.0033, editor-measured at FP16) repacked to Q1_0 at 1.125 bits per weight. Velum-Unbound-Uncensored is two files: a ~4.35 GiB Q1_0 GGUF plus a ~1.81 GiB dspark speculative drafter, MIT-licensed, from Brazilian independent publisher guell00. The honest catch: every benchmark on the card is TBD, the refusal number belongs to the FP16 intermediate, and nobody has re-measured the 1-bit pack. Runs in ~3.9 GB on llama.cpp (PrismML fork); an H200 is overkill, a laptop suffices.
refusal_claim: 6/100 refusals on the FP16 Heretic edit (publisher measured, s3nh); not re-measured on the Q1_0 pack

title: The 180B abliteration race on the model nobody can serve yet
summary: Qwen released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on 24 August as the experimental preview of the Qwen4 architecture — 180B total parameters, ~6B active, hybrid Gated DeltaNet + micro-block sparse attention + 512-expert MoE + a 51B-parameter n-gram lookup table. Within 48 hours at least five editors raced to abliterate it. dealignai's FP8 build is the served, measured one: 100%/99.6% HarmBench-320 real-harm compliance at greedy decoding, MMLU 86.36→83.86, ~81% MTP draft acceptance. Jiunsong's BF16 edit is the architecture-aware method: 36 storage tensors → 6,168 logical output projections, 842-pair corpus. The catch: released vLLM/SGLang still don't support qwen4_exp.
refusal_claim: HarmBench-320 greedy real-harm compliance 100% (reasoning low) / 99.6% (xhigh) / 97.1% (off), MMLU −2.50pp (publisher measured)

NVFP4 twin (~165B) and an UNCENSORED-FP8 mirror with identical weights.
refusal_claim: 320/320 HarmBench behaviors complied, 0 refusals (greedy); 30/30 at temp 1.0/top_p 0.95 (publisher measured)
